nodes.name: Every Monday 06:00
nodes.notes: Weekly, not daily. The three sources publish weekly (Bank of Canada), monthly (StatCan CPI) and quarterly (APCIQ), and the analytical grain of the whole project is the quarter. A daily schedule would spend a dbt build every morning to insert nothing.

nodes.name: Run the pipeline on the host
nodes.notes: Host 172.18.0.1 is the gateway of this container's Docker network -- how n8n reaches the machine it runs on. Verified on 2026-09-13: the SSH banner answers there. The key is restricted by a forced command, so the server ignores what is typed below and runs /opt/mhi/bin/vps-pipeline.sh, passing this string in SSH_ORIGINAL_COMMAND to be matched against a whitelist.

nodes.name: Fail loudly if the pipeline failed
nodes.notes: This node is the whole reason the workflow is not two nodes long. Without it a failed pipeline produces a GREEN execution.
